I've got a project that depends on Mathlib, and I wanted to see the new "hidden" declarations generated by a declaration in a Mathlib file. So, I went to the relevant file, which was write-protected, but I toggled off the protection "for the current session". I could then write whatever I wanted in this Mathlib file, yet the whatsnew in command returns an error. It works nicely, though, if I try it on files from my project. Is this expected/intentional ?

EDIT It seems OK!
Ops... I cannot reproduce now! I wonder if I did something strange this afternoon (while teaching). Now everyhing is fine --- sorry for the noise!
Filippo A. E. Nuccio has marked this topic as resolved.
